module page_title_length
  purpose: Download a web page and count the characters in its title element.

import std.http as web
import std.regex

public type TitleMissingError
  purpose: The page did not contain a title element.
  has message: Text
end

public function title_character_count(url: Url)
  returns Integer
  or fails with TitleMissingError
  needs network.http
  purpose: Download a web page and return the number of characters in its title element.
  tags: web, title
  expose as tool
  example: title_character_count(url: Url("https://example.com")) is 7

  let page be web.get(url) otherwise fail
  let title_pattern be raw "<title>(.*?)</title>"
  let title_match be page.matches(title_pattern) otherwise fail with TitleMissingError(message: "The page has no title element.")
  let title_text be title_match
  return title_text.length()
end

module page_title_tool

import std.http as web
import std.regex

public type TitleError is one of
  NoTitle
  HttpError
end

public function title_character_count(url: Url)
  returns Integer
  or fails with TitleError
  needs network.http
  purpose: Download a web page and return the number of characters in its title element.
  expose as tool
  example: title_character_count(url: Url("https://example.com")) is 7

  let page be web.get(url) otherwise fail with HttpError
  let title_start be page.index_of("<title>")
  if title_start is less than 0 then
    fail with NoTitle
  end

  let title_open_end be title_start + 7
  let title_end be page.index_of("</title>") otherwise -1
  if title_end is less than 0 then
    fail with NoTitle
  end

  let title_text be page.drop(title_open_end).take(title_end - title_open_end)
  return title_text.length()
end
